_comment: Plan 5.4 item 7: 24 known-item queries (8 DE_DE, 8 DE_EN, 8 EN_EN) on one topic of the owner's choice, each with one target passage id of the local corpus; concept nodes with their full label paths and 50 passages labelled by the owner.
